summary: Of the 10 flagged: one was a broken link to the wrong Wikipedia article title (fixed); three dates were adjusted or marked as traditional to match the article (the Achaemenid conquest of the Indus valley, the First Buddhist Council, Aditya I’s conquest of Tondaimandalam); one description was corrected (the Treaty of Salbai restored the position after the Treaty of Purandar, 1776, not “the status quo of 1775”); and five approximate or traditional dates that the article does not state were left as labelled approximations (Mahinda in Sri Lanka, the Iron Pillar of Delhi, Pulakeshin II and Harsha, Xuanzang at Nalanda, Vikramashila). The 65 that passed only mean each number appears somewhere in the article: this check looks at years and figures, not at wording, emphasis or omissions.
